messages:
Jon (docs): Opened a tiny PR to add an on-prem audit-export example + SOC2-safe retention phrasing. Need a legal/security pass. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/700
Ethan (eng): On it. Note: on-prem exports can surface local network IPs depending on configuration. For docs examples we should always show a placeholder like "<redacted>" and call out tenant-controlled values.
Marta (security): +1. Use "<redacted>" for IP/email and "pseudonymized or redacted" in the explanatory copy. Also add a short sentence about export integrity (e.g., "exports include an opaque export_signature for integrity; implementations vary"). Do not prescribe crypto.
Priya (legal): Quick wording reqs: replace any "anonymized" with "pseudonymized or redacted". Add: "Export contents depend on customer retention settings and deployment mode (hosted/dedicated/private)."
Ethan (eng): I'll add a minimal JSONL sample + CSV header mapping in the PR. Sample (fenced): ```json
{"__meta":{"export_id":"exp-700","export_time":"2025-12-01T00:00:00Z"},"timestamp":"2025-12-01T00:00:00Z","hashed_actor_id":"sha256:abcd...","actor_type":"user","event_type":"login","ip":"<redacted>","details":{}}
```
console-team: For the on-prem guide please add a short callout with the path to the local retention config and link to the admin UI page so operators know where to change TTLs.
lint-bot: docs lint check - sample JSON fenced correctly; no blocking issues.
Jon (docs): Thanks — updated PR to include the export_signature note, CSV mapping table, and the admin UI link. Requested legal ACK. Will merge after ACK + CI green. :thumbsup:
